mapper.select: SELECT id,name,phone_number,company_name,notes,version FROM fcc_customer WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND owner_work_no=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_customer SET name=#{customer.name},phone_number=#{customer.phoneNumber},company_name=#{customer.companyName},notes=#{customer.notes},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND owner_work_no=#{owner} AND id=#{customer.id} AND version=#{customer.version}
